strengths.note: Formal-charge and VSEPR heuristics are explicitly qualified.
Hypervalent bonding no longer claims literal vacant-d-orbital expansion as fact.
MOT/VSEPR controls pass isolated runtime and responsive browser checks.

findings.learner_impact: Role and curriculum depth can be misrepresented to learners.
findings.detail: LPAP.C1A.AUTHORITY.BINDING@1 — Claimed Core1A/Grade-9 role has no exact registry binding; the related canonical resource is an unbound JEE extension.
findings.suggested_fix: Establish a canonical package/capability binding or reclassify as an extension/resource variant.

findings.learner_impact: Publication would create ambiguous lineage and colliding question/search identity.
findings.detail: LPAP.C2.IDENTITY.SOURCE_COLLISION@1 — BOND-Q01 duplicates the existing published BOND-Q01; candidate BOND-Q02..Q04 reuse existing suite IDs for different questions/sources.
findings.suggested_fix: Reuse canonical BOND-Q01; establish source-backed identities for other items only after custody reconciliation.

findings.learner_impact: The learner route blurs construction versus assessment/source-custody roles.
findings.detail: LPAP.C1A.ROLE.MIXED_BANK@1 — The Core1A artifact mixes Concept Book construction with an unbound JEE question bank.
findings.suggested_fix: Separate or canonically bind the bank portion and keep the Core1A construction role explicit.

overall.summary: Local content/runtime quality was improved and the exact browser matrix passes, but authority/source/lineage obligations remain unresolved. This is a coaching recommendation, not an Owner disposition.
